patents.title: Methods, systems, articles of manufacture and apparatus for producing generic IP reputation through cross protocol analysis
patents.snippet: Cross-protocol analysis of IP telemetry to produce a generic IP reputation score. Signals gathered from one protocol (for example email) are combined with signals from another (for example web) so a unified reputation can inform defenses across channels.

patents.title: Methods and apparatus to analyze network traffic for malicious activity
patents.snippet: Analyzes network traffic to flag likely malicious activity. Extracts features from observed traffic and uses cross-signal analysis to identify connections associated with command-and-control, phishing infrastructure, and other abuse at scale.
